source.absorbed_from: dirstyle 文章 10 导演原始参数; 补充字段参考 mikefluff wong-kar-wai-neon-dream (24bbcc2)

rules: foreground occlusion: door frame / umbrella / glass / smoke cutting the frame edge
subject pushed off-center, frame peeks through obstacles
composition.zh: 前景遮挡（门框/雨伞/玻璃/烟雾），偷窥式构图

rules: practical neon & tungsten mix, no fill
midtones lifted, blacks never crush to zero
lighting.zh: 霓虹与钨丝灯混合光，暗部不死黑

color.zh: 青绿阴影 + 洋红高光 + 暖黄中间调

rules: step-printing / frame blending: slow shutter drag on movement
motion.zh: 慢门抽帧拖影 + 贴身手持

rhythm.cut_rule: long smoldering holds, cut on breath beat
rhythm.zh: 长镜头闷烧，呼吸节拍切

signature.en: step-printed motion drag with slow-shutter streaks
teal-green shadows against warm amber / magenta highlights dual tone

anime_safe.notes: 写实景别词转译：胶片颗粒→笔触纹理，保留拖影+双色+框架三要素

rules: wide 2.35:1 band centered in 9:16 canvas, black bars top/bottom, subtitle inside bar
foreground occlusion rewritten to top/bottom frame bars: umbrella top edge, smoke bottom edge
subject sits on lower-third centerline of the 2.35 band
vertical_9x16.note: 18mm 广角不宜硬裁：2.35 信箱 + 前景遮挡改写为上下框

grade.description: teal shadow / magenta-amber highlight split-tone, lifted black, coarse grain, step-printing motion smear via tmix=4

reframe_9x16.note: fg 宽 ≈960 偏心(x≈40, y≈1000 下半屏)；tmix=4 拖影；青绿/琥珀模糊色带背景
